description: Flask planning must preserve nox execution and route integration coverage without treating configured branch coverage as proof.

lockedFields.reason: The explicit nox tests session should remain the project-native command.
Coverage configuration must not hide the untested session service.
The covered Flask route remains an integration review target.
The Flask route target identity must remain stable.
Flask route behavior belongs at integration level.
The framework-specific Flask signal must remain visible.
The route test preserves exact module import evidence.
The imported route callable remains visibly invoked.
The untested service identity must remain stable.
Configured branch coverage is not source-specific test evidence.

unexpectedVariations: falling back from nox to pytest
coverage config treated as source coverage
